# Email Design Skill

Email Design Skill is a skill package for responsive email design, component systems, and accessibility checks.

Install:

```bash
npx skills add emaildesignskill
```

## Primary agent resources

- Markdown index: https://emaildesignskill.com/index.md
- Skill page: https://emaildesignskill.com/skill/index.md
- Raw SKILL.md: https://emaildesignskill.com/skills/emaildesignskill/SKILL.md
- Skill discovery JSON: https://emaildesignskill.com/.well-known/skills/index.json
